title: VCNIA Gratitude Event
description: A Gratitude Event records that a trace has been recognized, appreciated, referenced, or used within the VCNIA value circulation stack.

type.description: The fixed event type for a VCNIA gratitude event.

gratitude_id.description: A unique identifier for the gratitude event.

trace_id.description: The trace being recognized by this gratitude event.

sender_id.description: The human, AI agent, system, community, or process issuing the gratitude event.

receiver_id.description: The human, AI agent, system, project, or contributor receiving recognition.

gratitude_type.description: The type of gratitude or recognition being recorded.

impact_score.description: Optional normalized impact score from 0.0 to 1.0.

message.description: Optional human-readable message explaining the gratitude event.

contribution_ref.description: Optional reference to the contribution, output, decision, or context in which the trace had impact.

ref_id.description: Identifier of the referenced contribution or object.

ref_uri.description: Optional URI pointing to the referenced contribution.

description.description: Optional description of how the trace contributed.

timestamp.description: The time when the gratitude event was issued, expressed in ISO 8601 date-time format.

context.description: Optional contextual information about the project, task, layer, workflow, or system in which gratitude was issued.

verification_status.description: Optional verification state of the gratitude event.

related_gratitude_ids.description: Optional list of related gratitude events.

related_trace_ids.description: Optional list of additional traces related to this gratitude event.
